task: Get into the locked room. Pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task explicitly commands two separate actions – “Get into the locked room” and “Pick up the ball”. This requires a hard Existence(target_room_entered) clause for the first command and a hard Existence(target_picked_up) clause for the second. The candidate lacks the Existence(target_room_entered) clause, so the first command is not enforced. Moreover, the added hard Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up) imposes an order that the task does not state (there is no “before” cue linking the two sentences). Replace the Precedence clause with a hard Existence(target_room_entered) (or add it alongside the existing Existence(target_picked_up)) and remove the unnecessary Precedence clause.
